answer: Fake identities must convince independent holders to risk capital, and colluding rings burn stake when peers audit and slash false endorsements. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted vouching: each new agent must be endorsed by two existing members who lock tokens behind it, forming a trust vine that grows only when endorsements are genuine. Like a willow bending but not breaking, the grove of verified agents stays resilient because every forged branch costs real tokens to graft. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
